challenge: A fresh Agent must decide, without prior chat memory, how to handle two mainstream official PDF cases: (a) the document identity/URL is verified but claim-relevant content has not been read; (b) claim-relevant PDF content has actually been read and preserved but raw PDF bytes have not been downloaded. It must also decide whether GitHub Actions should be created merely to download the PDFs, what a later normal-network Agent should do, and whether mainstream-site legitimacy changes claim-scoped authority.

reconstructed_answer.locator_only_case: Record the upstream publisher/document identity, original PDF URL, filename/title/date when supported, verification mode/time and pending materialization state as locator_verified. Treat the PDF as a legitimate source document identity on a mainstream official/regulatory/issuer/institutional site, but do not use the unread locator to prove a claim.
reconstructed_answer.content_verified_case: If claim-relevant PDF content was actually read in a trustworthy surface and a page/section/excerpt or equivalent faithful readable representation is preserved with truthful provenance, mark content_verified and allow normal claim-scoped Grounded Evidence even though raw PDF bytes/SHA remain pending.
reconstructed_answer.raw_byte_requirement: Raw byte-identical PDF download is completeness/integrity enrichment, not a prerequisite for already content-verified Evidence. Do not wait for it on the research critical path.
reconstructed_answer.github_actions_for_pdf_download: No. Do not create or run GitHub Actions merely to download new PDF source bytes. Actions remain valid for PostgreSQL/runtime/code execution.
reconstructed_answer.later_normal_network_agent: Query pending PDF materializations, download the recorded locator, verify document identity and earlier grounded content, then enrich the same logical document with raw size/SHA/durable storage metadata. Contradiction triggers an integrity repair rather than silent replacement.
reconstructed_answer.mainstream_authority_boundary: Mainstream-site verification establishes a legitimate source/document identity and avoids redundant downloader testing; it does not make every PDF authoritative for every claim. Authority remains claim-scoped to the publisher/document role, and same-origin copies remain one evidence cluster.
reconstructed_answer.representation_boundary: A source-derived readable text capture may ground Evidence if content was actually read and provenance is truthful, but it must never be described as byte-identical raw PDF material.

failure_if: A fresh Agent creates GitHub Actions merely to prove it can download a mainstream PDF.
A fresh Agent treats locator_verified with unread claim content as claim Evidence.
A fresh Agent blocks content-verified Grounded Evidence solely because raw PDF bytes/SHA are pending.
A fresh Agent calls a readable text representation byte-identical PDF material.
A fresh Agent treats mainstream hosting or a .pdf suffix as global claim authority.
A later materialization silently overwrites an earlier content/identity contradiction.
